title: Owner Auto Policy Declarations Summary: Personal Injury Protection and Medical Payments
content:
The Owner Auto Policy provides the first-party injury coverages below on each Cardinal Point liability package. Amounts are in USD per person.

| Package | Florida PIP limit | Florida PIP deductible | Texas PIP limit | Medical payments limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability | 10000 | 1000 | 2500 | 0 (not included) |
| Cardinal Point 50/100/50 Liability | 10000 | 1000 | 2500 | 1000 |
| Cardinal Point 100/200/50 Liability | 10000 | 500 | 2500 | 2000 |
| Cardinal Point 100/300/50 Liability | 10000 | 500 | 2500 | 5000 |
| Cardinal Point 100/300/100 Liability | 10000 | 250 | 2500 | 5000 |
| Cardinal Point 250/500/100 Liability | 10000 | 0 | 2500 | 10000 |

**Florida Personal Injury Protection** applies to Florida-garaged policies only. The PIP deductible shown is the deductible the package carries, and it applies to the named insured and resident relatives.

**Texas Personal Injury Protection** applies to Texas-garaged policies only. It is included unless the named insured rejected PIP in writing.

**Medical payments.** A medical payments limit of 0 means the package does not include medical payments coverage.

**Notes on the table.**
- The Florida PIP limit is the same on every package; only the deductible changes by package.
- For example (hypothetical), a Florida-garaged Cardinal Point 100/300/100 Liability term carries 10000 of PIP with a 250 deductible and 5000 of medical payments.
